deckTitle: MedKayfab Urology 01 — The Renal Reservoir: Pressure, Pipes, and the Pelvic Vault

cards.power: The Evil-Squeeze. Grows in Transition-Alley, narrowing the Urethra-Tunnel.
cards.lore: Driven by DHT. Stromal/epithelial cells multiply into a mechanical barrier causing Frequency-Frenzy.
cards.gradeReason: Name alone is the role. You ARE the gatekeeper — no setup needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ink cartoon rhino bouncer blocking a urethra tunnel gate. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: BPH guard. Mood: smug obstruction.

cards.power: The Tunnel-Block. Triggers Peristaltic-Panic and the Colic-Scream. Deadliest at the UVJ-Border-Crossing.
cards.lore: Formed by Salute-Saturation when Fluid-Tokens are low. Deadliest at the UVJ-Border-Crossing.
cards.gradeReason: Colic-Scream and Tunnel-Block are instant embodiment. Zero ambiguity.
cards.artworkPrompt: Spiky crystal monster wedged in a pink tube, radiating pain lightning. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: kidney stone villain. Mood: excruciating blockade.

cards.power: The Back-Flow-Hammer. Downstream blocked + fluid crushes Filter-Gears.
cards.lore: Obstructive Uropathy. Renal-Pelvis pressure exceeds Glomerular-Filtration-Force, halting urine production.
cards.gradeReason: Back-Flow-Hammer describes mechanism, not a performable role. Clinical explanation over invitation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Puffer fish inflating inside a kidney pelvis, crushing gears beneath. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: hydronephrosis pressure bomb. Mood: swelling inevitability.

cards.power: The Narrowing-Trip. Turns a Highway into a Thread-Thin-Path.
cards.lore: Spongio-Fibrosis creates a permanent, non-elastic bottleneck following a Surgical-Scuff.
cards.gradeReason: Narrowing-Trip describes geometry, not a character to inhabit. Functional not performative.
cards.artworkPrompt: A scarred road narrowing to a thread with a stop sign, scar tissue creeping inward. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: urethral stricture. Mood: claustrophobic permanence.

cards.power: The Red Mist. Grows on the Bladder-Wallpaper, causing the Blood-Leak.
cards.lore: The Field-Effect. Entire lining is threatened because Chemical-Vandals touched every inch.
cards.gradeReason: Red Mist and Surface-Crawler give a character arc, but Field-Effect needs a beat of explanation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Red ink-stain octopus spreading across a tiled bladder wall. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: transitional cell carcinoma. Mood: insidious creep.

cards.power: The Silent-Grower. Starts in the Outer-Plains. Doesn't block flow until massive.
cards.lore: Androgen-dependent. Exploits the Testosterone-Signal to breach the Prostate-Capsule.
cards.gradeReason: Silent-Grower is a strong persona but PSA stats anchor it in diagnosis rather than performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Armored nodule quietly expanding in a peripheral zone fortress. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: prostate cancer. Mood: patient menace.

cards.power: The VHL-Vandal. Builds its own Blood-Pipe-Network to break into the Renal-Vein-River.
cards.lore: Linked to VHL-Blueprint-Glitch. Creates Erythropoietin-Sparks (Paraneoplastic).
cards.gradeReason: VHL-Vandal and Fortress-Breaker work well, but paraneoplastic jargon breaks the flow.
cards.artworkPrompt: Clear-cell monster drilling its own pipeline into a renal vein, sparks flying. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: renal cell carcinoma. Mood: aggressive infrastructure.

cards.power: The Youth-Invasion. Takes over the Kidney-Arena in Childhood-Knights.
cards.lore: Blastema-Cells fail to mature into Filter-Gears. They multiply wildly in Warrior-Form.
cards.gradeReason: Youth-Invasion and Kidney-Wrestler are vivid but WT1 mutation stat and blastema jargon require context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Chubby cartoon frog-wrestler pinning a kidney in a childhood arena. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: Wilms tumor pediatric. Mood: unexpected childhood takeover.

cards.power: The Blood-Choke. The Spermatic-Cord twists, cutting off the Arterial-Flow.
cards.lore: The Ball-Clapper-Uniformity. Unanchored testis spins freely, trapping its own pipes.
cards.gradeReason: Blood-Choke + 6-hr window STAT = pure urgency. You feel the time pressure immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Blue coiled snake twisting a glowing cord, clock in background ticking down. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: testicular torsion. Mood: surgical emergency.

cards.power: The Heat-Trap. Vein-Valves fail → blood pools → raises Arena-Temperature.
cards.lore: The Nutcracker-Effect. Renal-Vein gets squeezed, causing back-pressure into the scrotum.
cards.gradeReason: Bag-of-Worms is an unforgettable image. Nutcracker-Effect needs anatomical context to land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Purple tangled worm-veins in a scrotal sac, thermometer rising. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: varicocele heat trap. Mood: slow smoldering damage.

cards.power: The Rapid-Replacement. A painless mass replaces normal tissue with an Armor-Block.
cards.lore: A germ-cell riot. Highly Radiation-Sensitive — melts when hit by the Roentgen-Ray.
cards.gradeReason: Radiation-Sensitive weakness + Painless mass = character with dramatic Achilles heel. Instant drama.
cards.artworkPrompt: Giant glowing snail-shell mass in a testis arena, wilting under radiation beam. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: seminoma. Mood: painless but doomed.

cards.power: The Fluid-Buffer. Scrótum fills with clear fluid; organ feels Weightless-and-Soft.
cards.lore: Abdominal-Gateway fails to close after descent, leaking Peritoneal-Water.
cards.gradeReason: Fluid-Buffer is gentle and clear, but the role is passive — harder to perform than to observe.
cards.artworkPrompt: Translucent balloon jellyfish glowing inside a scrotal cave, soft and heavy. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: hydrocele. Mood: harmless but weighty.

cards.power: The Well-Irritant. Colonize the Bladder-Lining, triggering the Urgency-Sting.
cards.lore: Urethra-Tunnels aid access. Pilli-Hooks resist the Urine-Washout.
cards.gradeReason: Well-Irritant and Urgency-Sting work. LORE partly obscured by stamp reduces full grading.
cards.artworkPrompt: Spiked punk bacteria in purple mohawks, hooking onto a bladder lining wall. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: cystitis punk bugs. Mood: hostile colonization.

cards.power: The High-Invasion. Travels up the Ureter-Tunnels to cause Systemic-Shock.
cards.lore: Ascending infection. Neutrophil-Riot in the Renal-Parenchyma leaves Scar-Ruins.
cards.gradeReason: High-Invasion is strong but Ascending infection is clinical narration, not embodiment trigger.
cards.artworkPrompt: Army of bacteria scaling ureter ramps to storm a kidney fortress on fire. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: pyelonephritis siege. Mood: escalating invasion.

cards.power: The Glandular-Glow. Swollen Prostate-Gate makes every Fluid-Exit a painful battle.
cards.lore: A Bacterial-Sanctuary. Hard for Antibiotic-Artillery to penetrate the Prostate-Armor.
cards.gradeReason: Bacterial-Sanctuary hiding from antibiotics is clever, but Glandular-Glow undersells the ache.
cards.artworkPrompt: Red pulsing gland fortified with shields, antibiotics bouncing off its armor walls. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: prostatitis. Mood: entrenched infection.

cards.power: The Flesh-Melt. A Bacterial-Fire-Storm eats the Perineal-Armor in hours.
cards.lore: Polymicrobial sabotage. Toxin-Gas creates bubbles under skin, killing Blood-Supply-Roads.
cards.gradeReason: Flesh-Melt + Bacterial-Fire-Storm = visceral dread. No explanation needed. You are the emergency.
cards.artworkPrompt: Multi-headed bacterial hydra melting flesh-armor in hours, gas bubbles rising. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: Fournier gangrene. Mood: necrotizing apocalypse.

cards.power: The Premature-Squeeze. Squeezes without warning before reaching the Sanitary-Zone.
cards.lore: A Neuro-Misfire. The Bladder-Wall shouts 'EMPTY NOW!' even when the Reservoir is low.
cards.gradeReason: Premature-Squeeze with EMPTY NOW dialogue is perfect. You can feel the character's chaos.
cards.artworkPrompt: Frantic pink frog squeezing itself before reaching a restroom door. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: urge incontinence. Mood: panicked premature action.

cards.power: The Valve-Fail. High Abdominal-Pressure overwhelms the unsupported Sphincter-Gate.
cards.lore: Mechanical-Support is gone, often following Childbirth-Spells or Pelvic-Surgery.
cards.gradeReason: Valve-Fail is mechanically clear but doesn't trigger a persona to embody — more diagnostic.
cards.artworkPrompt: A gate hinge snapping open under a pressure blast from above, water spilling. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: stress incontinence. Mood: mechanical failure under load.

cards.power: The Reservoir-Build. Overfilled with Static-Fluid, forced to Leak-at-the-Edges.
cards.lore: Obstructive or Atonic. The Bladder-Wall is stretched so the Flames of Squeeze-to-Victory power [text cut off].
cards.gradeReason: Reservoir-Build describes a state, not a performance. LORE text was cut off — weakens the card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Sloth sitting in an overflowing bathtub, dripping over the edges lazily. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: overflow incontinence. Mood: passive overflow.

cards.power: The Disconnect. The Brain-Bunker and Bladder-Fortress stop speaking.
cards.lore: Loss of Pontine-Micturition-Center signal. High-damage if Sphincter and Detrusor fire simultaneously.
cards.gradeReason: The Disconnect is a great concept but neurogenic dyssynergia requires context to feel.
cards.artworkPrompt: Cut telephone wire between a brain fortress and bladder fortress, static sparking. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: neurogenic bladder. Mood: severed command.

cards.power: The Inner-Melt. Carves away the Gatekeeper-Gland from the inside out.
cards.lore: Creates a Wide-Open-Funnel to fully re-open the Urethra-Highway.
cards.gradeReason: Inner-Melt is satisfying and clear, but it's a procedure card — role is instrument, not character.
cards.artworkPrompt: Electric wire loop boring through a clogged orange tube, debris melting away. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: TURP procedure. Mood: precise surgical relief.

cards.power: The Bypass-Pipe. Slips past the Obstruction-Outlaws to empty the Reservoir.
cards.lore: Inflatable-Water-Balloon keeps it inside. Essential for Acute-Retention-Crises.
cards.gradeReason: Drain-Master persona is immediate. Bypass-Pipe is a clear action but lacks theatrical punch.
cards.artworkPrompt: Snake-catheter with inflated balloon anchor sliding through an orange pipe. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: Foley catheter. Mood: reliable bypass hero.

cards.power: The Sonic-Hammer. Sound-Bursts smash the Stone-Stunner into Sand-Dust.
cards.lore: Focuses acoustic energy at the Focal Zone to shatter the crystal lattice.
cards.gradeReason: Sonic-Hammer smashing stones to dust is one of the most satisfying powers in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Cartoon shockwave machine firing at a crystal enemy, exploding to grains. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: lithotripsy sound machine. Mood: sonic obliteration.

cards.power: The Tunnel-Prop. Keeps the Ureter-Highway open through swollen walls.
cards.lore: Curl at Both-Ends (Double-J) prevents slipping into the Bladder-Basin or Kidney-Vault.
cards.gradeReason: Bridge-Builder persona is clear and useful. Double-J mechanism adds texture without overwhelming.
cards.artworkPrompt: J-shaped scaffold bridge propped inside a swollen pink tunnel, both ends curling. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: ureteral stent. Mood: structural support.

cards.power: The Adrenaline-Flood. Sprays Combat-Hormones causing The-Pounding-Heart.
cards.lore: Chromaffin cell riot. Palpating the Flank can trigger the Hormone-Grenade.
cards.gradeReason: Adrenaline-Flood + Hormone-Grenade + don't-touch-the-flank rule = perfect crisis character.
cards.artworkPrompt: Squirrel on fire spraying adrenaline lightning bolts in all directions. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: pheochromocytoma. Mood: explosive hormonal chaos.

cards.power: The Fluid-Hoarder. Forces filters to Keep-the-Salt and Dump-the-Potassium.
cards.lore: Adrenal-Adenoma. Bypasses the Renin-Feedback to raise Pressure-Engine.
cards.gradeReason: Salt-Sucker with dump-potassium mechanics gives this villain a clear anti-RAAS performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Golden bird eating a salt shaker, potassium pellets flying out. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: Conn syndrome hyperaldosteronism. Mood: greedy fluid monopoly.

cards.power: The Fortress-Expansion. Morphs into a massive Cluster-of-Water-Balloons, destroying functional filters.
cards.lore: Genetic-Source Code Glitch. Tube-Cilia Sensors fail, causing them to balloon.
cards.gradeReason: Fortress-Expansion describes the pathology well but is hard to perform. More visual than playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Frog morphing into a massive grape cluster, squashing tiny filter machinery. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: ADPKD. Mood: slow genetic takeover.

cards.power: The Filter-Hole. The Kidney-Mesh (Podocytes) is torn, leaking the Albumin-Shields.
cards.lore: Loss of the Negative-Charge Barrier. Water leaks into Leg-Paddles and Eye-Bags.
cards.gradeReason: Filter-Hole is accurate but passive — you describe what's leaking, not who you are.
cards.artworkPrompt: A torn fishing net with proteins escaping, legs swelling in background. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: nephrotic syndrome. Mood: passive devastating leak.

cards.power: The Muscle-Melt. Relaxes the Smooth-Muscle-Grip of the Prostate-Gate.
cards.lore: Doesn't shrink the gland, just Relaxes-the-Clench. Risk of Retrograde-Splash.
cards.gradeReason: Flow-Opener persona works. Retrograde-Splash side effect gives it personality but needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Butterfly landing on a clenched fist gate, causing it to relax and open. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: tamsulosin alpha-blocker. Mood: gentle pharmacological relief.

cards.power: The Hormone-Starve. Cuts off DHT-Fuel, causing the gland to Wither-and-Shrink.
cards.lore: Blocks t → DHT conversion. Slowly alters the Volume-of-the-Obstacle.
cards.gradeReason: Hormone-Starve causing Wither-and-Shrink is immediately clear and satisfying to roleplay.
cards.artworkPrompt: Vulture cutting a DHT fuel line, a rhinoceros gland slowly deflating. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: finasteride 5ARI. Mood: slow hormonal starvation.

cards.power: The Spasm-Mute. Silences the Hyper-Active-Muscle to stop Urge-the-Impulse.
cards.lore: Blocks the Acetylcholine-Signal. Triggers The-Dry-Mouth and The-Blurred-Vision.
cards.gradeReason: Spasm-Mute is good but the side effects (Dry-Mouth, Blurred-Vision) are the memorable part here.
cards.artworkPrompt: Pink blob with headphones silencing a screaming muscle, dry mouth and foggy eyes floating. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: oxybutynin anticholinergic. Mood: calm-but-foggy side effects.

cards.power: The Reservoir-Expander. Relaxes the bladder during the Filling-Phase.
cards.lore: Mimics Sympathetic-Relaxation. A cleaner move for those avoiding Anticholinergic-Fog.
cards.gradeReason: Cleaner-move framing is clever for comparing drug classes. Reservoir-Expander is solid but mild.
cards.artworkPrompt: Chick resting in a soft expanding nest, no dry mouth fog nearby. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: mirabegron beta-3 agonist. Mood: gentle alternative relaxation.

cards.power: The Stagnant-Trap. Blood enters the Erectile-Arena but cannot leave.
cards.lore: Compartment-Syndrome. Drain with Phenylephrine-Injection-Needle to prevent-to-the-Scar.
cards.gradeReason: Stagnant-Trap in Erectile-Arena with 4-hour clock STAT makes this unmistakably urgent.
cards.artworkPrompt: Rhinoceros stuck at a one-way turnstile, blood arrows unable to exit. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: priapism. Mood: trapped against the clock.

cards.power: The Ring-Choke. The retracted Skin-Collar acts as a deadly Tourniquet.
cards.lore: Self-trap by blocking Lymphatic-and-Venous-Repatriolating a vicious Swelling-Cycle.
cards.gradeReason: Ring-Choke + deadly Tourniquet is immediately performable. The self-trap loop adds drama.
cards.artworkPrompt: A constrictor snake collar tightening around a purple swelling object. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: paraphimosis. Mood: tightening vicious cycle.

cards.power: The Wall-Burst. Tunica-Albuginea armor splits; blood floods the Scrotal-Plains.
cards.lore: Caused by bending force on the Erect-Pillar. A true Surgical-Repair-Emergency.
cards.gradeReason: Audible-Snap STAT + Wall-Burst power = one of the most viscerally performative cards in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Blue armored tube cracking with eggplant deformity, blood flooding surrounding plains. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: penile fracture. Mood: catastrophic audible snap.

cards.power: The Toxic-Overflow. Blocked + Infected = Bacteria forced into blood at high pressure.
cards.lore: The most lethal match. Must Drain-the-Fortress to stop the Storm.
cards.gradeReason: Most lethal match + must drain the fortress = pure emergency narrative. No setup needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Green bacteria storm flooding a kidney fortress into the bloodstream river. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: urosepsis. Mood: life-threatening overflow emergency.

cards.power: The Inflammation-Dug. Immune-Army attacks Filter-Gears, causing bleeding & pressure spikes.
cards.lore: Follows Strep-infection-Brawl. Membrane damaged by Immune-Complex-Dragoons.
cards.gradeReason: Immune-Complex-Dragoons is brilliant flavor. Red Riot as a name earns the energy but LORE is clinical.
cards.artworkPrompt: Medieval knight immune cells battering a glomerulus filter with siege weapons. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: nephritic syndrome. Mood: autoimmune riot aftermath.

cards.power: The Engine-Failure. Urine-processing tubes Melt and shed dead cells into the Drain-Pipe.
cards.lore: Leading cause of Sudden-Kidney-Halt in the ICU-Arena.
cards.gradeReason: Engine-Failure and Sudden-Kidney-Halt are strong. Muddy brown casts STAT is the perfect clue.
cards.artworkPrompt: Melting worm tubes dripping into a drain pipe, muddy cast debris floating. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: ATN acute tubular necrosis. Mood: ICU failure collapse.

cards.power: The Allergic-Kidney. The Spaces-Between become an allergic Battle-Zone.
cards.lore: Acute Interstitial Nephritis. Kidney is collateral damage in a Drug-Hypersensitivity-Riot.
cards.gradeReason: Collateral damage framing is clever but name and power are purely descriptive — no clear persona.
cards.artworkPrompt: Hedgehog zapped with lightning rash inside a kidney, pills ricocheting everywhere. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: AIN drug allergy. Mood: allergic bystander damage.

cards.power: The Starvation-Signal. Narrowed inflow makes kidney think the Arena is Dry, screaming for Renin.
cards.lore: Causes Renovascular Hypertension. Pressure sensor is violently fooled.
cards.gradeReason: Pressure sensor violently fooled + screaming for Renin = perfect performance of systemic deception.
cards.artworkPrompt: Kinked artery pipe, panicked kidney shouting Renin into a megaphone. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: renal artery stenosis. Mood: deceived sensor in crisis.

cards.power: The Gravity-Defier. Weak valve lets urine Splash-Back-Up to the kidney.
cards.lore: Vesicoureteral Reflux. Illegal-Backflow carries Bacteria-Punks directly to the Kidney-Fortress.
cards.gradeReason: Gravity-Defier + Bacteria-Punks hitchhiking up = immediate playable villain with a clear mechanism.
cards.artworkPrompt: Salmon-like urine stream surging upward against arrows, carrying punk bacteria riders. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: vesicoureteral reflux. Mood: illegal upstream flow.

cards.power: The Birth-Block. Skin-Flap blocks exit from day one, causing Total-System-Backup.
cards.lore: Top cause of newborn kidney failure. Bladder thickens trying to push past the wall.
cards.gradeReason: Birth-Block from day one + Total-System-Backup is immediately dramatic. Neonatal stakes are clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Cartoon wall with a valve flap blocking a newborn urethral exit, backup pressure building. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: posterior urethral valves. Mood: congenital obstruction.

cards.power: The Short-Tunnel. The Exit-Pipe opens along the Bottom-Shaft.
cards.lore: Urogenital-Folde failed to Zip-up during the Creation-Phase.
cards.gradeReason: Misfired-Exit captures the concept but the power is purely anatomical description, not a role.
cards.artworkPrompt: A zipper half-done on a blue cartoon structure, exit relocated to underside. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: hypospadias. Mood: developmental mis-zip.

cards.power: The Womb-Stayer. Fails to navigate the Inguinal-Tunnel, remaining in the Abdominal-Heat-Zone.
cards.lore: Requires the Orchiopexy-Fix before age 1 to bring him to the Cool-Scrotal-Arena.
cards.gradeReason: Hidden-Knight refusing his descent journey is a vivid hero narrative. Heat-Zone vs Cool-Arena is perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Armored knight hiding inside a glowing heat zone instead of descending to cool arena. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: cryptorchidism. Mood: reluctant hidden warrior.

cards.power: The Controlled-Riot. Pours Tamed-Bacteria into the basin to trigger a Massive-Immune-Fire.
cards.lore: Macrophage-Margie cleaners hunt the BCG and Accidentally destroy the TCC-Crawler.
cards.gradeReason: Controlled-Riot is outstanding — immune chaos weaponized intentionally. Macrophage-Margie is charming.
cards.artworkPrompt: Lizard pouring tamed bacteria into a basin as macrophage janitors mop up cancer cells. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: BCG bladder treatment. Mood: controlled friendly-fire immunotherapy.

cards.power: The Nerve-Spare. Enters the Pelvic-Vault through tiny holes to remove the Mine.
cards.lore: 3D Vision and Endo-Wrist precision saves the Erection-Facility in the Deep-Dark-Basin.
cards.gradeReason: Nerve-Spare mission with Erection-Facility stakes is good drama. Precision is a character, not a crisis.
cards.artworkPrompt: Robotic arthropod surgeon operating through tiny holes in a pelvic vault, nerves glowing. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: robotic prostatectomy. Mood: precise laparoscopic calm.

cards.power: The Mitosis-Stop. Freezes the Cell-Skeleton so testosterone-independent cancer can't divide.
cards.lore: Microtubule stabilizer. Locks the Cancer-Cells in permanent Ice-Stasis.
cards.gradeReason: Ice-Stasis and Mitosis-Stop are vivid. CRPC STAT requires prior knowledge to fully land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Cartoon hammer freezing a cell skeleton mid-division in a block of ice. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: docetaxel chemo. Mood: cold permanent mitosis halt.

cards.power: The Internal-Sniper. A Radioactive-Calcium-Mimic targets the Bone-Scars.
cards.lore: Targeted-Alpha-Therapy. Short-range lasers kill the Tumor-Politic without hurting neighbors.
cards.gradeReason: Internal-Sniper hiding as calcium = best spy concept in the deck. Precision assassination energy is perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Glowing bee with alpha-particle stinger targeting bone-scar tumors, healthy tissue untouched. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: radium-223 Xofigo bone seeker. Mood: lethal internal precision.

cards.power: The Direct-Witness. The Camera-Snake confronts TCC or Stone-the-Stunner face-to-face.
cards.lore: The Gold-Standard for Bladder Secrets. Allows a Biopsy-Bite to confirm the Antagonist.
cards.gradeReason: Camera-Snake is vivid but Scope is a diagnostic tool — observing, not performing. Limited roleplay.
cards.artworkPrompt: Camera-eyed snake peering inside a lit bladder, spotting a red lurker ahead. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: cystoscopy. Mood: investigative direct encounter.

cards.power: The Stream-Judge. Tells if the Fluid-Tokens are leaving fast enough.
cards.lore: A functional Plumbing-Test. A weak stream means BPH-the-Gatekeeper is winning.
cards.gradeReason: Stream-Judge is a referee, not a character to embody. Diagnostic utility cards resist performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Beaver professor holding a speed gauge under a stream, marking BPH score. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: uroflowmetry. Mood: methodical measurement.

cards.power: The Left-Behind-Checker. Scans the Reservoir after a pee.
cards.lore: > 100ml is a Red-Flag-Signal for Overflow-the-Drip or Obstruction.
cards.gradeReason: Left-Behind-Checker is functional and clear but purely instrumental — it checks, doesn't perform.
cards.artworkPrompt: Raccoon with ultrasound probe checking leftover fluid in a bladder reservoir. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: post-void residual scan. Mood: post-pee detective work.

cards.power: The Waste-Counter. Trash-Tokens build up in the blood as filters fail.
cards.lore: A Lagging-Indicator. High Creat means the Kidney-Fortress has been under siege for a while.
cards.gradeReason: Lagging-Indicator framing is honest but Creati is a lab value — hardest card to embody in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Owl in lab coat counting trash tokens stacking in blood, fortress crumbling behind. Style: Kayfabizarro comic. Subject: creatinine lab value. Mood: delayed forensic accounting.

verdict: MedKayfab Urology 01 is a complete, systematically strong deck that covers the full urology curriculum in character form — every organ system, every emergency, every treatment. The naming convention (Character-the-Role) fires on nearly every card, and the andrological emergencies page (Priapism, Paraphimosis, Penile Fracture, Urosepsis) is the strongest four-card spread in the MedKayfab series to date. Weakness: the diagnostic tools page (page 14) sacrifices performance for completeness — Scope, Flow, PVR, and Creatinine read as instruments, not characters. Table-ready: Yes.
blurb: 52 urology villains, heroes, and tools turned into playable characters — from BPH-the-Gatekeeper blocking the pipes to Radium-the-Bone-Seeker hunting metastases. Built for med students who'd rather embody anatomy than memorize it.

marketingText:
MedKayfab: UROLOGY 01 – Stones, Tumours & the Arsenal That Fights Them (Medical Mnemonics Cut & Play Comic)

52 illustrated medical mnemonic cards to master stones and obstruction, the urologic cancers and the treatments built to fight them, and the infections that escalate into urosepsis.

Urology is the one specialty where the cure is often stranger than the disease. To break a kidney stone, you aim focused sound waves through the body wall and let the stone leave as gravel, no incision, no scalpel. To treat an early bladder cancer, you pour a live tuberculosis vaccine into the bladder on purpose and let a controlled immune fire burn the tumour out. To fight prostate cancer that has reached the skeleton, you give a radioactive element that pretends to be calcium, walks itself into the bone metastases, and irradiates them from the inside. Learn urology as a flat list of diseases and you miss the better half of the story: the instruments answering back.

MedKayfab Urology 01 turns the whole urological arsenal into a roster, every stone, tumour, infection, and the tool sent to deal with it wearing a face and a motive. Stop memorizing which weapon answers which problem. Start reaching for it before the question finishes.

What's in the deck
The roster runs from the quiet villains to the loud ones. BPH-the-Gatekeeper throttles the outflow until the bladder gives up its fight without complaint. ESWL-the-Wave-Smasher answers the stone with focused shock waves and nothing else. BCG-the-Immune-Fire is the live vaccine instilled straight into the bladder to start the immune blaze that clears superficial cancer. Radium-the-Bone-Seeker hunts prostate metastases through the skeleton itself. And Sepsis-the-Uro-Storm is the one that refuses to wait: an obstructed, infected system that tips from uncomfortable to septic shock in the time it takes to find a free theatre.

How it works
Every card is a cognitive anchor built for high-stress retrieval. You have the Character (the mnemonic), the Visual (the scene), the Stat Block (the numbers that matter), the Lore (the clinical story), and the Quest (the challenge). The Mechanism Flash mode is the test that bites: if you cannot explain what the tool does, or why the obstruction is the lethal part, in one sentence without looking, the patient on the Stage does not make it.

Honest cognitive load
This is a clinical-years deck. It suits medical students on a surgery or urology rotation, anyone heading into a urology exam, and residents who want the arsenal to feel automatic instead of looked-up. It pairs naturally with Nephrology for the medical kidney sitting just upstream of the plumbing, and with Oncology for the cancer-drug logic underneath BCG and Radium.
